summary: Pangasinan 5th District representative with 29 principal-authored bills. Rubric-relevant items are a general private-sector minimum wage and the national minimum wage system, both one labor issue. No dimension reaches two adequately evidenced issues.
caveat: Few rubric-relevant bills surfaced; the rest of the portfolio was not individually reviewed.
